card.title: Apologize Properly
card.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

mechanism: A requires an apology at the relevant table and before the witness whose mistaken understanding must first be corrected.
confusable: Unlike merely wanting acknowledgment of harm, A insists on the apology's location, audience and order.
comparison: A public correction about cake precedes sorry; the email alternative demands responsibility before apology in the subject.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
